{{2021–22 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2021–22 South Alabama Jaguars men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of South Alabama]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Jaguars, led by fourth-year head coach [[Richie Riley]], play their home games at the [[Mitchell Center]] in [[Mobile, Alabama]] as members in the [[Sun Belt Conference]].

The Jaguars are set to play in the inaugural [[2022 The Basketball Classic]] postseason tournament.<ref>{{cite web |title=Jag Men's Basketball Selected to Participate in The Basketball Classic |url=https://goccusports.com/news/2022/3/11/mens-basketball-to-host-opening-round-game-of-the-basketball-classic.aspx |website=usajaguars.com |publisher=University of South Alabama |access-date=March 11, 2022 |date=March 11, 2022}}</ref>

==Previous season==
In a season limited due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 South Alabama Jaguars men's basketball team|Jaguars]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 17–11, 10–7 in Sun Belt play to finish in third place in the East Division. In the [[2021 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]], they defeated [[2020–21 Louisiana–Monroe Warhawks men's basketball team|Louisiana–Monroe]] in the first round,<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://sunbeltsports.org/news/2021/3/6/mens-basketball-flowers-sends-south-alabama-into-quarterfinals.aspx|title=Flowers Sends South Alabama into Quarterfinals|work=Sun Belt Conference|access-date=December 23, 2021|language=en}}</ref> before losing to [[2020–21 Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns men's basketball team|Louisiana]] in the quarterfinals.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://usajaguars.com/news/2021/3/6/louisiana-rallies-to-eliminate-south-mens-basketball-from-sun-belt-tourney.aspx|title=LOUISIANA RALLIES TO ELIMINATE SOUTH MEN'S BASKETBALL FROM SUN BELT TOURNEY|work=University of South Alabama Athletics|access-date=December 23, 2021|language=en}}</ref>
